ext_description.message: AI-generated — to be rewritten by me. Find pages on Sejong University websites, record their menus, read them in English.

language_name.description: This language's own name, shown in Settings → UI language.

close.description: Close button of the translation overlay (tooltip).

no_answer.description: Internal error: background script did not answer.

search_placeholder.message: baholarim qayerda? · where are my grades? · 성적 조회
search_placeholder.description: Search box placeholder: example questions in Uzbek, English, Korean. Keep the examples.

open_item.description: Opens a menu item's page in this tab.

backend_error.message: $error$ Start it with: .venv/bin/uvicorn api.main:app --port 8000 (or change BACKEND_URL in config.js; now $url$).
backend_error.description: The search server is not running.

cannot_guide.message: Cannot guide on this tab ($error$). Open a Sejong page first.

status_here.message: You are there: “$name$” is highlighted. Click it to finish.

status_hint.description: step_of is the 'Step X of Y' text.

status_kor_only.message: $kor_only$. Switch the site to KOR, then look for “$name$”.

status_missing.message: $step_of$: “$name$” is not visible on this page yet.

status_other_tab.message: $step_of$: “$name$”. This tab is not a Sejong page; switch to the Sejong tab.

hint_new_tab.message: It opens in a new tab; the guide continues there.

kor_only.message: This menu only appears in Korean mode (KOR)
kor_only.description: Shown when an SJPT menu has no English-mode version.

reload_page.message: Reload this page (Cmd+R) to start the guide.
reload_page.description: The extension could not start on an already-open tab.

no_click_path.message: No click path to this item.

other_guide_running.message: A guide to “$name$” is running. “Show me” replaces it.

setting_keep_english.message: Keep English menu labels on Sejong sites

setting_translate_popups.message: Translate Korean pop-ups to English (on this computer)

settings_reload_note.message: Reload the Sejong tab after changing these two.

display_widget_hint.message: The widget appears on Sejong pages. The toolbar icon shows or hides it.

display_panel_hint.message: Click the Sejong Navigator toolbar icon to open the side panel.

setting_ui_language.description: Label of the UI language choice.

ui_language_auto.description: UI language choice: follow Chrome's language.

no_guide_running.message: No guide is running. Press + to search.

backend_unreachable.message: Backend not reachable at $url$. Is the server running?

no_path_to_follow.message: This item has no click path to follow.

bad_url.message: Only http and https links can be opened.

popup_title_popup.description: Overlay title for a translated pop-up window.

popup_title_dialog.description: kind is alert, confirm or prompt (code: do not translate).

translator_needs_download.message: Chrome can translate Korean on this computer, but needs a one-time download (~ tens of MB). Nothing is sent to a server.

no_translator.message: No translator available. Use Chrome 138+ (built-in on-device translator) or start a self-hosted LibreTranslate and set TRANSLATE_URL in config.js.

rec_intro.message: Records ONLY menu labels, links/selectors and nesting on the Portal, SJPT, e-Campus and Library sites. Never page content, grades, names or student IDs.

rec_next_child.message: Next click becomes a child of:

rec_delete_item.message: Delete this item and everything below it

rec_clear_confirm.message: Delete ALL recorded items? Export first if you want to keep them.

rec_recording.message: Recording. Click through the menu on the page, from the top level down to the page you want.

rec_no_sejong_page.message: No Sejong page in this tab (or reload the page once after installing the extension).

rec_new_path_done.message: New path: the next click hangs under the site root.

site_portal.description: Site name on buttons and results.

site_sjpt.description: Site name on buttons and results (the academic information system).

site_ecampus.description: Site name on buttons and results.

site_library.description: Site name on buttons and results.

site_in_portal.description: Site name inside a sentence: 'is on the Portal', 'already in the Portal'.

site_in_library.description: Site name inside a sentence: 'already in the Library'.

site_in_other.description: Fallback site name inside a sentence.

status_other_site.description: The step to click is on another Sejong site than this tab.

open_site.description: Button: open (or switch to) that site's tab.

already_on_site.description: The result is a link into the site the student is on.

show_instead.description: Button: guide to this result on the current site.

answer_seat_booking.message: Reading-room seats are issued at the kiosks (1F, 3F, 4F); they can't be booked online. You can book a study room, cinema room or S-Lounge table online.

answer_see_free_seats.description: Answer card button: guide to the live seat status (libseat).

answer_cinema_room.description: Answer card button: book a cinema room.

answer_slounge.description: Answer card button: book an S-Lounge table.

hint_room_booking.message: Pick a room, then a time. Rooms must be booked for at least half their capacity.
hint_room_booking.description: Shown when a guide to a room booking finishes (libseat opened in a new tab).

hint_new_tab_external.message: It opens in a new tab.
hint_new_tab_external.description: Appended to a status line: the step opens a site where the guide does not run (e.g. libseat).

already_here.description: A guide was started to the page the student is on.

arrow_up.message: The next step is above. Click to scroll to it.
arrow_up.description: Tooltip of the orange arrow at the top edge of the page.

arrow_down.message: The next step is below. Click to scroll to it.
arrow_down.description: Tooltip of the orange arrow at the bottom edge of the page.
